en: The National Park is through the north door. The Pokéathlon Dome is through the west one!
In the Pokéathlon it isn't strength alone that counts. Speed, skill, stamina and jumping all have their turn.
My Pokémon lost every battle, but it won a race at the Pokéathlon! Now it walks with its head held high.
I came to watch the Bug-Catching Contest and found the Pokéathlon on the other side. Now I can't decide which to watch!
A poster of the Pokéathlon. It says "Through the west door!"
A poster of the Pokéathlon's events: racing, jumping, throwing and more.
text: Un afiș cu probele Pokéathlonului: alergare, sărituri, aruncări și altele.
